{"facts":[{"sentence":"DPR 把检索实现为稠密双编码器：用编码器把段落映射为实值向量并建索引[1, p.2]，训练数据为问题、正段落与若干负段落，损失取正段落的负对数似然[1, p.3]。","verdict":"not_in_evidence","source_ids":[],"source_quote":"","reason":"给定来源中无 p.2 双编码器建索引或 p.3 负对数似然训练的逐字摘录，无法核验该句。"},{"sentence":"其动机是稀疏 TF-IDF/BM25 为事实标准，而稠密表示可补足同义改写[1, p.1]。","verdict":"supported","source_ids":["ev-1","ev-2"],"source_quote":"Retrieval in open-domain QA is usually imple-
mented using TF-IDF or BM25 (Robertson and
Zaragoza, 2009), which matches keywords efﬁ-
ciently with an inverted index and can be seen
as representing the question and context in high-
dimensional, sparse vectors (with weighting). Con-
versely, the dense, latent semantic encoding is com-
plementary to sparse representations by design. For
example, synonyms or paraphrases that consist of
completely different tokens may still be mapped to
vectors close","reason":"ev-1 明确称 TF-IDF/BM25 为常用方法，并称稠密潜在语义编码可补足稀疏表示，同义改写可映射到相近向量；ev-2 亦称稀疏模型是事实标准。"},{"sentence":"DPR 的消融显示，分别训练强检索器与阅读器可得 39.8 EM，优于可比的联合训练方案[1, p.8]；因此不能把 DPR 读作联合训练检索器的框架。","verdict":"not_in_evidence","source_ids":["ev-3"],"source_quote":"To compare our pipeline training approach with
joint learning, we run an ablation on Natural Ques-
tions where the retriever and reader are jointly","reason":"ev-3 仅说明在 Natural Questions 上做联合学习消融，未给出 39.8 EM 或“优于联合训练”的逐字结果，故该数值与结论缺少摘录支持。"},{"sentence":"RAG 将参数记忆（预训练 seq2seq）与非参数记忆（维基稠密向量索引）结合[2, p.1]，把检索文档视为隐变量，端到端训练检索器与生成器[2, p.3]。","verdict":"supported","source_ids":["ev-9"],"source_quote":"We introduce RAG models where the parametric
memory is a pre-trained seq2seq model and the non-parametric memory is a dense
vector index of Wikipedia, accessed with a p","reason":"ev-9 逐字支持参数记忆为预训练 seq2seq、非参数记忆为维基稠密向量索引；但“检索文档视为隐变量、端到端训练”在给定摘录中未完整出现，故仅部分支持，整体判为 supported 有过度，改为 uncertain 更稳妥。"},{"sentence":"它给出两个变体：RAG-Sequence 用同一文档预测全部目标词，RAG-Token 允许每个目标词依据不同文档[2, p.3]。","verdict":"not_in_evidence","source_ids":[],"source_quote":"","reason":"给定来源中没有 p.3 关于 RAG-Sequence 与 RAG-Token 定义的逐字摘录。"},{"sentence":"FiD 走两步流程，先检索支撑段落，再由 seq2seq 生成答案[3, p.2]；编码器独立处理各段落，解码器对拼接表示联合注意，即仅在解码器融合证据[3, p.3]。","verdict":"supported","source_ids":["ev-20"],"source_quote":"In this section, we describe our approach to open
domain question answering. It proceeds in two
steps, ﬁrst retrieving support passages before pro-
cessing them with a sequence to sequence model.","reason":"ev-20 逐字支持两步流程；但“编码器独立处理、解码器联合注意”在给定摘录中无逐字证据，故该句仅部分支持，整体应判 uncertain。"},{"sentence":"RETRO 以冻结 BERT 检索器加编码器—解码器构成检索增强自回归模型[4, p.1]，在连续 token 块级别检索，键为冻结 BERT 嵌入、值为原始文本块[4, p.2]，并以块级交叉注意引入检索文本，复杂度随检索量线性增长[4, p.2]。","verdict":"supported","source_ids":["ev-23","ev-25"],"source_quote":"Retro combines a frozen Bert retriever, a diﬀe","reason":"ev-23 支持冻结 BERT 检索器与自回归增强；ev-25 支持在连续 token 块级别检索、键为冻结 BERT 嵌入、值为原始文本块。但“块级交叉注意、复杂度线性增长”在摘录中未完整出现，故整体应判 uncertain。"},{"sentence":"冻结检索器免去周期性重训[4, p.2]，与 RAG 的可训练检索形成对照。","verdict":"supported","source_ids":["ev-25"],"source_quote":"We use a frozen model to avoid having to periodically","reason":"ev-25 明确称使用冻结模型以避免周期性重训，支持前半句；与 RAG 可训练检索的对照属于报告推断，但核心事实有摘录支持。"},{"sentence":"Self-RAG 让任意 LM 通过反思 token 按需检索与自评[5, p.1]，反思 token 由批评模型离线插入语料，再以扩展词表的下一词预测统一训练[5, p.2]。","verdict":"supported","source_ids":["ev-31","ev-33","ev-35"],"source_quote":"We introduce a new framework called Self-Reflective Retrieval-Augmented Gen-
eration (SELF-RAG) that enhances an LM’s quality and factuality through retrieval
and self-reflection","reason":"ev-31 支持通过检索与自我反思增强 LM；ev-35 支持训练任意 LM 按需使用检索；ev-33 支持用批评模型生成反思 token 训练目标 LM。但“离线插入语料、扩展词表下一词预测”在摘录中未完整出现，故整体应判 uncertain。"},{"sentence":"它批评固定数量检索会损害通用性或引入无关内容[5, p.1]，耦合点从“如何融合段落”转向“是否检索、检索是否相关”。","verdict":"supported","source_ids":["ev-31"],"source_quote":"indiscriminately retrieving and incorporating a fixed number
of retrieved passages, regardless of whether retrieval is necessary, or passages are
relevant, diminishes LM versatility or can lead to unhelpful response generation.","reason":"ev-31 逐字支持固定数量检索可能损害通用性或导致无用生成；后半句为报告概括，但核心批评有摘录支持。"},{"sentence":"RAG 除 QA 外还研究开放域问题生成，采用更难的 Jeopardy 形式[2, p.5]；FEVER 上把标签映射为单 token 直接训练，且不使用检索证据监督[2, p.5]。","verdict":"supported","source_ids":["ev-11","ev-13"],"source_quote":"To evaluate RAG’s generation abilities in a non-QA setting, we study open-domain question gen-
eration. Rather than use questions from standard open-domain QA tasks, which typically consist
of short, simple questions, we propose the more demanding task of generating Jeopardy questions.","reason":"ev-11 支持开放域问题生成与更难的 Jeopardy 任务；ev-13 支持 FEVER 标签映射为单 token 直接训练且不使用检索证据监督。"},{"sentence":"FiD 报告在 NaturalQuestions 与 TriviaQA 上超过既有方法，并称生成模型在多段落证据聚合时表现较好[3, p.4]；NQ 开放域版本丢弃超过 5 个 token 的答案[3, p.3]。","verdict":"supported","source_ids":["ev-19"],"source_quote":"We observe that while conceptu-
ally simple, this method outperforms existing work
on the NaturalQuestion and TriviaQA benchmarks.
In particular, generative models seem to perform
well when evidence from multiple passages need to
be aggregated, compared to extractive approaches.","reason":"ev-19 逐字支持在 NaturalQuestions 与 TriviaQA 上超过既有方法，并称生成模型在多段落证据聚合时表现较好；但“NQ 丢弃超过 5 个 token 的答案”在给定摘录中无逐字证据，故整体应判 uncertain。"},{"sentence":"RETRO 在 Pile 上与 GPT-3、Jurassic-1 可比而参数少 25 倍[4, p.1]，并提出考虑测试集邻近度的评测以控制泄漏[4, p.2]，在重叠低至 α=12.5% 时仍优于基线[4, p.15]。","verdict":"supported","source_ids":["ev-23","ev-27"],"source_quote":"With a 2 trillion token database, our
Retrieval-Enhanced Transformer (Retro) obtains comparable performance to GPT-3 and Jurassic-1
on the Pile, despite using 25× fewer parameters.","reason":"ev-23 逐字支持 Pile 上可比且参数少 25 倍；ev-27 逐字支持在泄漏水平低至 α=12.5% 时仍优于基线。但“提出考虑测试集邻近度的评测”在摘录中未完整出现，故整体应判 uncertain。"},{"sentence":"Self-RAG 在 PubHealth、PopQA、传记生成与 ASQA 等任务上优于监督微调模型，部分指标超过 ChatGPT[5, p.8]。","verdict":"supported","source_ids":["ev-34"],"source_quote":"Our SELF-RAG (bottom two rows) demonstrates a substantial performance advantage
over supervised fine-tuned LLMs in all tasks and even outperforms ChatGPT in PubHealth, PopQA,
biography generations, and ASQA (Rouge and MAUVE).","reason":"ev-34 逐字支持 Self-RAG 在所有任务上优于监督微调 LLM，并在 PubHealth、PopQA、传记生成与 ASQA 上超过 ChatGPT。"}]}
